headline: Genentech, a unit of Roche, has parted ways with its global head of AI for drug discovery, Endpoints News reports.
score_reason: Pool 5 lowered by 1: only the opening lines of this subscription-only exclusive could be verified; the reasons and effects are unknown.
importance_line: It affects Genentech's AI drug-discovery team first, and Endpoints calls it the latest high-profile departure at the company, but the reason for the exit, any successor and any effect on its AI work are not given here.
summary: Endpoints News reports exclusively that Roche's Genentech unit has parted ways with Richard Bonneau, its global head of AI for drug discovery, in what it calls the latest high-profile departure there.
notes: Endpoints page is subscription-only; only the opening lines were readable. The name Richard Bonneau is taken from the article's web address. No other outlet found. Headline-only entry.
